extracted.name: Five-Can Soup
extracted.description: This delicious five-can soup recipe only requires heating the prepared ingredients together to deliver a quick and easy soup the entire family will love.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can prepared chili with beans (such as Hormel®)
1 (10.75 ounce) can vegetable beef soup (such as Campbell's®)
1 (10.75 ounce) can tomato soup (such as Campbell's®)
1 (10 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers (such as RO*TEL®)
instruction_lines: Stir chili, corn, vegetable beef soup, tomato soup, and diced tomatoes together in a saucepan over medium-high heat; cook until hot, 5 to 10 minutes. Serve warm.
